method.effectiveSelection: Exact loadWorkspaceCoverageData plus coverage-matrix.ts steps 1–7; canonical product effort and current selection; no optimizer.
method.correlation: Spearman rho using observed pairs with tied average ranks; simple unweighted mean across eligible pairs.
method.dimensionAssignment: Current primaryDimension only; secondary tags do not make duplicate observations.
method.baseModelSensitivity: Choose one fixed profile per model by highest quality52 coverage, then highest effort, then lexicographic profile ID. Never choose a profile per benchmark.
method.residualDiagnostic: Exclude the two target benchmarks; median observed benchmark percentile rank per row from >=5 other scores. Regress pair-specific ranks linearly on that median and correlate residuals. Changes in source mixture, score availability and residual common factor can confound this proxy; it is not a factor model.
method.uncertainty: No p-values or latent dimension count. Shared profiles, related model families, common training and overlapping test tasks violate simple independent-pair assumptions; model collapsing only partially addresses dependence.

approvedSixCommonCore.interpretation: Six model rows cannot establish latent dimension count: centered rank is at most five. No n>=15 pairs are possible. SVD is only an algebraic diagnostic.
